PLAN "12-week Meniscus-Friendly Strength for Recreational Skier"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Increase strength and prepare for skiing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Load Management" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Strength A":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower Strength A":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Upper Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Strength A":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 4x6..8 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower Strength A":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Upper Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Strength B":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x5 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower Strength B":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x5 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x4 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Upper Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          preacher_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          skull_crusher 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Deload Upper":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x5 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Deload Lower":
        warmup:
          cycling 6m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Mobility & Core":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
        main straight_sets:
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
  PHASE "Phase 2: Strength Progression" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Upper Heavy":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_dip 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 70m "Lower Heavy":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3 rpe 8.5 rest 150 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Upper Volume":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x8 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Upper Heavy":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 8.5 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 5x5 rpe 8.5 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_dip 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 70m "Lower Heavy":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 5x3 rpe 8.5 rest 150 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x5 rpe 8.5 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Upper Volume":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          preacher_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          skull_crusher 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Upper Peak":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 6x3 rpe 8.5 rest 150 seconds
          bent_over_row 5x4 rpe 8.5 rest 120 seconds
          military_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x8 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 70m "Lower Peak":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 6x3 rpe 8.5 rest 150 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 5x3 rpe 8.5 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Accessory & Stability":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
        main straight_sets:
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          single_leg_hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Deload Upper":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x5 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Deload Lower":
        warmup:
          cycling 6m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Mobility & Core":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
        main straight_sets:
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
  PHASE "Phase 3: Ski-Specific Strength & Preparation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Upper Strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 8.5 rest 150 seconds
          dumbbell_row 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          military_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x8 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 70m "Lower Ski Prep":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 5x3 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x4 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          lateral_lunge 3x8 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Stability & Endurance":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          single_leg_hip_thrust 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 4x8 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank_up 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Upper Power-End":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 6x3 rpe 8.5 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          arnold_press 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x8 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 70m "Lower Power-End":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3 rpe 8.5 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Balance & Core":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
        main straight_sets:
          pallof_press 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 4x60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 4x8 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Taper":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x4 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower Taper":
        warmup:
          cycling 6m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x4 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x4 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 3x8 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Mobility & Pre-Ski Prep":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
        main straight_sets:
          lateral_lunge 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          single_leg_hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Final Strength Check":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x3 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 3x3 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower Maintenance":
        warmup:
          cycling 6m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x3 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Recovery & Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
        main straight_sets:
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
